findings.label: Live-OCR path not widget-tested
findings.detail: Every scanner_screen_test case uses liveOcr: false, so the stream -> setLiveOcr -> DetectionBoxesOverlay wiring and live-driven phase advancement are never mounted, despite FakeScanCameraController already supporting canned frames. Add one liveOcr: true widget test replaying frames and asserting the overlay plus a non-initial phase caption.

findings.label: Flash UI can desync from hardware
findings.detail: _toggleFlash sets _flashOn via setState unconditionally, but CameraPackageController.setFlash swallows a setFlashMode failure, so the toggle can read FLASH ON while the torch is off. Surface success/failure from setFlash (or re-read flashOn) and reflect actual state.

findings.label: Evidence thumbnail re-reads bytes every rebuild
findings.detail: _EvidenceTile calls image.file.readAsBytes() inline in build, creating a fresh future each rebuild and re-decoding/flickering the thumbnail. Cache the decoded bytes.

findings.label: Concurrent-capture guard missing
findings.detail: Capture button and + Add tile are gated by _busy (set only during analyze), not by an in-flight capture, so a fast double-tap can call takePicture() twice concurrently and surface a snackbar. Add a capture-in-progress flag.

findings.label: startImageStream lacks post-await mounted recheck
findings.detail: In _initCamera, setState runs after startImageStream without re-checking mounted, so disposing mid-start could setState on a defunct state. Re-check mounted before the final setState.

findings.label: shared_core/admin_web untouched not provable from git
findings.detail: The repo reorg left everything untracked, so there is no baseline diff to prove packages/shared_core and apps/admin_web were not edited. Verdict relies on the verification attestation plus the fact that all scanner writes are under apps/user_app; diff those trees against a known-good copy for certainty.
